*   **`renderDashboard()`:** Displays the initial landing view, including the upload zone and quick action buttons.
*   **`renderReaderView(textData)`:** Transitions the UI to the reading mode, populating the display with the provided text and setting initial reading parameters.

*   **`handleFileDrop(file)`:** Triggered by the `#uploadZone`. Accepts files (`.txt`, `.pdf`, `.odt`, `.epub`).
